title: Pool gauge never scaled; at x1.25 the scaled SLA header renders on top of it
evidence:
app/main.odin:1172:
		rnd.draw_pool_gauge(&app.view, &app.state.flow, &app.cat, app.drop_marks[:], app.tick, 12, app.view.win_h - 118)
app/render/visibility.odin:86-96:
	label := fmt.aprintf("POOL %d/%d", in_flight, cap, allocator = context.temp_allocator)
	draw_text_c(v, label, x, y, 15, p.ink)

	// the fill bar (chunky, like the health meter — 8 px per 10% at 80 px)
	bar_x := x + 118
	bar_y := y + 4
	bar_w := i32(80)
	bar_h := i32(9)
app/main.odin:1537:
	draw_text(app, "SLA - delivered / dropped / avg ms (tol) / breach  |  click a row to focus", 12, app.view.win_h - rnd.hud(&app.view, 96), rnd.hud(&app.view, 16), p.ink_soft)
detail: Deliverable 3 requires "chrome stays legible at each step"; the PR claims hud() threads through "SLA/pool gauges". At x1.25 the scaled SLA header (y=win_h-hud(96)=600, 20px) and the unscaled pool label (y=win_h-118=602) overlap text-on-text at x=12.
recommended_fix: Thread hud() through draw_pool_gauge (fonts, bar, x+118 tag offset) and anchor the call at win_h - hud(118); pin the no-overlap invariant in hud_test like crisis_card_width.

title: SLA gauge row geometry unscaled: 24px fonts on a 16px pitch collide at x1.50; hit rects no longer cover rows
detail: hud(16)=24px at x1.50 on a fixed 16px row pitch → consecutive gauge rows overlap by 8px (descender-bearing strings like "gaming … avg"); the shared 18px hit/highlight rect stops covering the text, breaking the PR's "single-source with hit-tests" claim. No golden covers draw_hud.
recommended_fix: Scale the rows: sla_row_y -> win_h - hud(80 + line*16), sla_row_rect height/pitch via hud(); add a hud_test pinning row separation and rect coverage at x1.25/x1.50.

title: Run-HUD/game-over y-ladder fixed while fonts scale — leading collapses at x1.50
evidence:
app/main.odin:1069:
	draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2", 12, 10, rnd.hud(&app.view, 22), p.ink)
app/main.odin:1104:
		draw_text(app, "click to place; ESC / right-click cancels", 12, 36, rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink)
app/main.odin:1110:
		draw_text(app, score, 12, 56, rnd.hud(&app.view, 16), p.ink_soft)
app/main.odin:1156:
		draw_text(app, lead_s, 12, 76, rnd.hud(&app.view, 14), p.ink_soft)
app/main.odin:1094:
		draw_text(app, "press R or Enter to retry (fresh run, fresh seed)", 12, 104, rnd.hud(&app.view, 16), p.ink_soft)
detail: PR body claims hud() threads through "every HUD surface: … run HUD". Only font sizes scale; the fixed ladder (10/36/56/76/104, toast 68) leaves ~3px gaps between 21-45px lines at x1.50 (vs ~10px at x1.00) — descender collisions and degraded legibility at the knob's max.
recommended_fix: Scale the ladder positions through hud() (y=hud(10)/hud(36)/hud(56)/hud(76); game-over hud(68)/hud(104)) so spacing grows with the fonts; hud() is the identity at x1.00.

title: Compiled Python bytecode artifact committed to the repo
evidence:
$ git ls-files tools/ | grep -i pyc
tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc
$ git diff --stat 3fa0703^..70e3e91 (tail)
tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc | Bin 0 -> 13615 bytes
detail: The spec's scope lists the derivation script under tools/; a 13.6KB build artifact is unasked-for bytes that will silently go stale against tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py (the committed derivation record).
recommended_fix: git rm --cached tools/__pycache__/derive_a11y_palettes.cpython-313.pyc and add tools/__pycache__/ to .gitignore.

title: PR claim "pulse_read — the single seam every animated pulse consumer routes through" is inaccurate
detail: The crisis-outline swell duplicates the reduced-motion gate inline instead of routing through pulse_read (view.odin:355). Behavior is identical today, but the claimed single seam doesn't exist — a future pulse consumer can bypass it.
recommended_fix: Use pulse_read(v, tick, u32(b), 0) for the outline factor (identical phase math) so the gate lives in one place.

title: "Input parity holds under every mode" (AC 1) has no per-mode parity leg
evidence:
$ grep -n "a11y|ui_scale|reduced" harness/parity.odin
674:	// Assert: ZERO world commands on every device (a11y is presentation-only)
harness/main.odin:296:
	fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png] | wire-preview [outdir]")
harness/parity.odin:976:
	btn := rnd.demolish_button_rect(pop)
detail: grep for a11y/ui_scale/reduced_mode hits only a comment at parity.odin:674 — no scenario sets any mode; ui_scale is the one mode changing hit geometry, so parity under it holds only by construction, and one fixture already uses the unscaled demolish fallback.
recommended_fix: Run the parity suite (or its UI-click subset) once with view.ui_scale=1.5 + a palette mode set, and pass the view at parity.odin:976.

title: Drawn hint "S / tap chip to close" is wrong when a pipe is selected
detail: Opening the panel via chip/Y with a pipe selected (mouse/touch-reachable) leaves S uncollected even while the modal is open, so the advertised S-close does nothing; Esc/chip/B/Y still close.
recommended_fix: Collect S when inp.panel_open regardless of sel_pipe (the modal already blocks the phase-2 lane keys), or reword the hint.
